In predictable fashion, the old man takes umbrage at the thought of being left behind in Shepherd's Bush, and insists on inviting himself along. Harry H Corbett and Wilfrid Brambell star in the last ever episode of the sitcom

events.name: Birds of a Feather
events.description: Travis has finally been allowed to fly the nest on a gap year to Spain, but nobody has heard from him in four days and he was last seen getting on a ferry to Morocco with his girlfriend. Tracey is convinced something terrible has happened to him so she heads off to Tangier to track him down and bring him back home for Christmas, accompanied by Sharon and Dorien. On arrival they end up in a bar run by Vince, one of Dorien's old flames, who reviews the CCTV footage and spots Travis being arrested in a police raid. Festive special of the comedy, starring Pauline Quirke, Linda Robson and Lesley Joseph, with Martin Kemp

events.description: The festive season is around the corner in Chigwell and Tracey has got big plans that could upset the harmony in the house over the holiday period. Laurence Marks and Maurice Gran's long-running comedy returns for a festive special, starring Pauline Quirke, Linda Robson and Lesley Joseph as the three friends and sparring partners, with Emily Atack

events.name: Birds of a Feather
events.description: Christmas is just around the corner in Chigwell, and there are big changes in the women's lives. Dorien is now ruling the roost, having bought the house, and she and Tracey have been getting on each other's nerves. To make matters worse, Tracey is missing sister Sharon, who is stuck on a cruise ship in Costa Rica, and Dorien is up to her old tricks with a rich dentist. Does he know what he's getting himself into? Return of the comedy, starring Linda Robson and Lesley Joseph, with Les Dennis and Ami Metcalf

events.name: Shameless
events.description: Ian joins the local boxing club to build up his confidence and quickly becomes friends with the owner Jock. When the club faces closure through lack of funds, he tries to raise the cash to keep it open, but uncovers Jock's debt to Paddy and finds himself embroiled in a feud. Meanwhile, Micky unsuccessfully applies for the fire service, but proves himself during a life-threatening emergency. Former world light welterweight boxing champion Ricky Hatton guest stars

event.name: Birds of a Feather
event.description: Travis has finally been allowed to fly the nest on a gap year to Spain, but nobody has heard from him in four days and he was last seen getting on a ferry to Morocco with his girlfriend. Tracey is convinced something terrible has happened to him so she heads off to Tangier to track him down and bring him back home for Christmas, accompanied by Sharon and Dorien. On arrival they end up in a bar run by Vince, one of Dorien's old flames, who reviews the CCTV footage and spots Travis being arrested in a police raid. Festive special of the comedy, starring Pauline Quirke, Linda Robson and Lesley Joseph, with Martin Kemp
